fix(combine): return a Response from a short-circuiting middleware in some() (#5391)

* fix(combine): return a Response from a short-circuiting middleware in some()

A middleware that short-circuits returns a `Response` without calling
`next()`, which does not assign `c.res`. `some()` matched the result
against `true` and `false`, then dropped it, so the context was never
finalized and hono-base threw "Context is not finalized", surfacing as
a 500.

`every()` has handled this since #3441, whose description is the same
report for the sibling: validators and `cors()` on OPTIONS return a
Response rather than calling `next()`. `some()` was not part of that
change.

Keeps the Response and returns it. A `true` that reaches the same branch
because the context is already finalized is excluded, so a Condition is
still never used as a response.

* docs(combine): remove redundant comments

fix(css): keep "//" inside an unquoted url() when minifying (#5450)

* fix(css): keep "//" inside an unquoted url() when minifying

The minifier strips "//" to the end of the line as a comment. An unquoted
url(https://...) or url(//cdn...) matched it too, so the rest of the
declaration and the next one were dropped:

  background-image: url(https://example.com/a.png);
  color: red;

became "background-image:url(https:color:red".


* fix(css): allow whitespace inside an unquoted url()

fix(css): keep the descendant combinator before a pseudo-class when minifying (#5451)

The minifier removed whitespace on both sides of ":", so in a nested
selector the space that means "descendant" was lost:

  & :first-child { margin: 0 }   ->  &:first-child{margin:0}
  .a :is(h1, h2) { color: red }  ->  .a:is(h1,h2){color:red}

That rule then matches the element itself instead of its descendants.
Only the whitespace after ":" is removed now.

fix(jsx): add the CSP nonce to all scripts generated by ErrorBoundary (#5430)

#4216 added `scriptNonce` support via `StreamingContext`, but two of the
three inline scripts ErrorBoundary emits while streaming were left without
the nonce:

- the script that swaps in the fallback when a child rejects during streaming
- the cleanup script emitted after all nested Suspense boundaries resolve

Under a nonce-based CSP these scripts are blocked, so the fallback is never
shown and the boundary markers are never removed.

The existing "with StreamingContext" test was asserting the nonce-less
cleanup script; it now expects the nonce, and a test for the error path is
added.

fix(ssg): do not reuse created directories across toSSG runs (#5381)

`saveContentToFile` remembered the directories it had created in a
module-level Set so that each one was only passed to `mkdir` once. That
Set was never cleared, so it outlived the `toSSG` call that filled it.

When `toSSG` runs again in the same process after the output was
removed (a clean step, a rebuild, a test that writes to a fresh
directory), every directory created by an earlier run is skipped and
`writeFile` fails with ENOENT for nested routes such as `/about/team`.

Keep the Set per run: `toSSG` creates one and passes it to
`saveContentToFile`, which falls back to a fresh Set when called on its
own.

fix(aws-lambda): sanitize non-ASCII header values in API Gateway v2 events (#5483)

EventV2Processor.getHeaders passed header values to Headers.set() as is,
so a request carrying a non-ASCII header value (for example Cloudflare's
cf-ipcity) was answered with 400 Invalid request. The v1, ALB and VPC
Lattice processors already encode such values with sanitizeHeaderValue().
Apply the same handling to v2 in both hono/aws-lambda and @hono/aws-lambda.

fix(jsx): escape element and object attribute values (#5512)

* fix(jsx): escape element and object attribute values

Render JSX nodes and other objects as escaped attribute text, including
promised values and asynchronous toString results. Mark precompiled JSX
templates so their child-content escaping is not trusted inside attributes.

Keep raw() and html values explicitly trusted, and prevent callbacks from
escaped nodes from propagating into the outer stream. Cover both runtimes
and the Deno precompile transform.


* perf(jsx): use a set for boolean attribute lookup

Use Set.has for boolean attribute membership without changing the accepted
attribute names or their rendering.

* fix(jsx): serialize boolean attributes in precompiled JSX

Omit false boolean attributes and emit an empty value for true ones in
jsxAttr, matching JSXNode. Preserve true/false text for non-boolean names.

* feat(jsx): support declarative Shadow DOM boolean attributes

Recognize shadowrootclonable, shadowrootdelegatesfocus, and
shadowrootserializable as boolean attributes. Cover true and false values
in both attribute serializers.


* fix(jsx): omit null style attributes

Skip null style values before traversing the style object in both
JSXNode and jsxAttr. Cover null and undefined omission.


* fix(jsx): validate function attributes in precompiled JSX

Skip on-prefixed event handlers and ref callbacks in jsxAttr. Reject
functions on other attributes with the same rule as JSXNode, including
when the Deno precompile transform calls jsxAttr.


* refactor(jsx): share attribute serialization between JSXNode and jsxAttr

Use attributeToBuffer for both render paths so attribute handling cannot
drift between them. Keep the explicit string conversion required by the
buffer type.

Handle dangerouslySetInnerHTML separately when the value is an object
with __html; other values follow the normal attribute serializer.

* perf(jsx): add a string fast path to jsxAttr

Escape string values directly in js
